title: Tongue-image deep learning model screens for gastric precancerous lesions
summary: The AITongue deep learning model combined tongue images with age, sex and Helicobacter pylori infection. Five-fold cross-validation in 1995 patients gave an AUC of 0.75, 10.3% higher than a model with risk factors alone, and a prospective follow-up cohort gave an AUC of 0.71. A smartphone app was also developed; discrimination is modest and the cross-validation is internal.
ai_technology: Deep learning model (AITongue) on tongue images plus clinical risk factors
organization: Institute of TCM-X, Department of Automation, Tsinghua University, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: Five-fold cross-validation in 1995 patients and an AUC of 0.71 in a prospective follow-up cohort.
evidence.unknown: Independent external validation and whether screening with the model improves outcomes; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep learning model extracted tongue-image features and integrated them with risk factors to screen for lesions.
